items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And the girl playing trombone, too, that came in here, that came in here with Redd Foxx?

ctx.x: Art Blakey was playing drums. Art Blakey -- I'm trying to think what trombone they had. They had --
And the girl playing trombone, too, that came in here, that came in here with Redd Foxx? [Melba Liston]-ed
She played trombone, nice trombone. And was that fellow named Green?
